items.prompt: Before processing the first item 3, why must ways[0] be 1 when the target is 3?

options.text: The empty predecessor creates the singleton.
options.why: Including the first item adds ways[0] to ways[3]; zero initialization would lose this valid one-item subset.

options.text: It means an empty subset already totals 3.
options.why: The empty subset totals 0, not the positive target.

options.text: It reserves one use of every future item.
options.why: The base count does not preselect any index.

options.text: It limits the answer to one subset for every target.
options.why: Other indexed choices can later contribute additional counts.
